cases.prompt: A person crawls forward slowly on their hands and knees.
cases.clearance_prompt: A person crawls forward slowly on their hands and knees. The torso and head stay elevated above the ground while the hands and knees support the body.

cases.prompt: A person lies on their back on the floor, rolls onto their side and pushes up to stand.
cases.clearance_prompt: A person lies on their back on the floor, rolls onto their side and pushes up to stand. The head stays clear of the floor during the roll, and the body remains compact during the push to standing.

comparisons: root-path versus baseline: original prompt, added sparse root guide
clearance-root-path versus root-path: same guides, added clearance wording
scope: Development probe on two ground actions and one fixed rig; not a motion whitelist, held-out evaluation, scene-aware checkpoint, source-clip repair, contact/semantic approval or release evidence. No vertical clip lift, rig change, postprocessing or relaxed pass limit. Root guides constrain XZ path/heading, not mesh collision or anatomical support.
